# Awesome Mise [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

Discover what is possible with [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/): a curated collection of tools, workflows, integrations, and real-world configurations. mise manages tool versions, project environments, and tasks.
